representation_fit.evidence: Primary representation is a single sequential release workflow: 6 phases / 14 steps (source/data.js:10-211) rendered as a phase timeline rail; step kinds map exactly onto a consequential flow — check (data.js:19-28), gate with metric thresholds and pass/fail judgment (data.js:86-107, app.js:123-146), and irreversible with phrase confirmation (data.js:109-125, 150-166). The brief's zero-mistake success standard is operationalized, not decorative: misjudging a gate or skipping confirmation records a mistake (app.js:83-88, 137-145) and the final certificate reports 零失误通关 vs N 次失误 (app.js:429-451).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen (1280x860.png, 1440x900.png): center stage shows the active step 1 of 14 (核对变更单与发布窗口) with its two checkboxes as the dominant element; left rail shows the full 14-step flow with step 1 highlighted; top bar carries 0/14 progress, 零失误 badge and timer. No competing task; 步骤 1/14 失误 0 in the stage footer (app.js:302).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: within seconds the screen conveys what (release command console for orders-api v2.4.0, change CHG-20260919-042, window 02:00–04:00 — index.html:16-23) and where (active step highlighted in rail at styles.css:144-152 and rendered as stage h1, app.js:245). Kind badges 逐项检查/执行操作/观察门禁/不可逆 (app.js:6) plus phase intent lines (data.js:11-16, rendered app.js:165) pre-explain each step's nature.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object is on screen at load with zero navigation (app.js:40, 554-556 renders step 1 immediately). Any unlocked step is viewable in one click via view-step on the same page (app.js:171, 466-470); locked steps are intentionally unreachable, which is intrinsic to a gated consequential flow rather than a navigation defect. No modes, tabs, or routes.

context_loss.evidence: Single-page state machine: all interactions (checkboxes app.js:471-479, actions 480-490, gate verdicts 495-496, recovery panels 497-516) mutate in-page state and re-render without navigation; viewing another step only changes viewIdx, not progress (app.js:466-470, separate from currentIdx at 101-102). Irreversible execution uses an in-page modal with cancel producing no record and Escape to dismiss (index.html:43-62, app.js:517, 544-546); recovery paths are inline <details> panels on the same stage (app.js:208-238, 317-328).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces: top bar, 292px phase rail, center stage, 316px status rail with 4 panels (styles.css:100-104, app.js:337-389). Each panel maps to the job (环境快照 = gate context, 不可逆步骤 = seed visibility, 失误记录 = success criterion, 操作日志 = audit trail), but at initial state 失误记录 and 操作日志 are near-empty permanent panels (both screenshots) and toasts duplicate log entries (app.js:75-82 vs 381-386), so surface count is slightly above strict need.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.target_size=fail, type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json checks; only a11y.focus_order passes). Corroborating source: custom checkbox targets are 18×18px (styles.css:191), metadata text at 10.5–11.5px (styles.css:158, 354, 87), and the --faint token #5b6a7d (styles.css:11) used for phase intents and step numbers (styles.css:124, 158) computes to roughly 3.3:1 on panel backgrounds, below the 4.5:1 AA threshold for that small text.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects in either screenshot, and layout.overflow / layout.responsive_collision / text.truncation all pass (measurement-summary.json), including the 1180px fallback (styles.css:486-491). Score held at 4 because three receipt failures (a11y.contrast, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) are defects implying a rework pass on token sizes and control dimensions.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径 is directly covered, twice over: both irreversible steps require typing a confirmation phrase (MIGRATE-217 at data.js:113, CUTOVER at data.js:154) in a modal (app.js:410-424, 518-533), and each carries an explicit recovery path (data.js:116-124, 157-165) — recovery paths also exist on all three gates (data.js:98-106, 139-147, 181-190). UI surfaces it: right panel 不可逆步骤 lists 短语 MIGRATE-217 · 恢复路径未查阅 (1440x900.png; app.js:356-364), the stage shows 恢复路径：建议先查阅 before execution (app.js:289, 297), and post-recovery retry re-judges the gate (app.js:508-516).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast fail per receipt; --faint #5b6a7d (styles.css:11) on dark panels used at 10.5–12px (styles.css:124, 158) is ~3.3:1, below AA for normal text
a11y.target_size fail per receipt; interactive checkbox is 18×18px (styles.css:191)
type.min_projected_size fail per receipt; pervasive 10.5–11.5px mono metadata (styles.css:87, 158, 354)
rail step items are clickable <li> without role/tabindex (app.js:171) — pointer-only affordance, though a11y.focus_order passed on the initial page
no visible layout defects at 1280x860 or 1440x900; layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation all pass
scores.overall_note: The package presents a release-drill command console whose representation matches the brief's consequential-flow shape tightly: a single 14-step, 6-phase workflow (data.js:10-211) with gated judgments, phrase-confirmed irreversible steps, inline recovery paths on every gate and irreversible step, and an explicit zero-mistake accounting system (mistake counter, 零失误 badge, final certificate) that mirrors the brief's 零失误走完全程 success standard. The primary task is dominant and reachable with zero navigation on load; all interaction is context-preserving on one page, including the confirmation modal. The acceptance seed (irreversible steps have recovery/confirmation paths) is not merely present but surfaced proactively (建议先查阅, 恢复路径未查阅 indicators). The clear weak area is accessibility: three of the four a11y/type receipt checks fail (contrast, target size, type size), consistent with 18px checkboxes, 10.5–11.5px faint metadata, and low-contrast token usage in the source; layout and text checks all pass with no visible defects. Model preference on the initial screen should not be read as human preference — no user study exists in this pilot.
